name: country_lookup
description: Look up a country or territory in Internacia by alpha-2 code, alpha-3, name, or Wikidata Q-id. Prefer official ISO codes; remap legacy KV→XK via countries_aliases.

code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (or user-assigned XK). Primary key.

name.description: English name or common alias substring.

official_iso_only.description: If true, filter code_status = official_iso3166_1 (249 records).
